# Varthana

> Varthana is India's leading education financing platform offering school loans and student education loans to support educational institutions and learners across the country.

Varthana provides comprehensive financing solutions for schools and students in India, with a focus on improving educational infrastructure and accessibility. The platform operates across multiple Indian states and maintains RBI compliance for all lending operations.
